title: Qualify reusable real published CLR binding admission in the existing Math Discovery probe
commitMessage: feat: admit selected Discovery bindings against real published CLR

contribution.summary: Reuse the existing published-CLR reflection probe as a callable selected-binding admission gate, refusing coherent forgeries without duplicating the package loader.
contribution.value: Extend ProbeM8SelectedClrReflectionRed.cs with a read-only --validate <manifest-path> mode. Reuse a single bounded AdmitRealPublishedBindings routine in both the existing RED --check path and the new CLI: verify the three SHA-pinned immutable private DLLs, exact four selected public static CLR methods, source pins and runtime-only authorization. The original three coherently signed forgeries must still pass metadata-only RS287 validation but be refused by the shared real-method gate; the unauthorized grant must remain refused. Keep T2-RED in-progress and historical assets/packages unchanged.
debtChanges: RS293 succeeded first-pass and established three coherent metadata-only forgeries that fail when matched against actual immutable private CLR binaries; T2-RED remains active.
The real-method reflection and SHA-pinned package loader already exist in ProbeM8SelectedClrReflectionRed.cs; extend that tool instead of creating a competing near-identical validator.
RS294 only qualifies a reusable local private-feed admission CLI; it cannot execute methods, grant broker permission, publish archives, complete RED/GREEN or assert external consumer adoption.
contribution.nextAction: After RS294 qualifies four selected real methods and three coherent forgery refusals, separately close T2-RED and ready T2-GREEN on exact new DWF evidence; do not backfill prior consumer reports.
